title: Fine-Tuning Methods — Train on Instructions and Responses
key_insight: Supervised fine-tuning formats each conversation with the model’s chat template and masks tokens that should not count as targets.
body:
## Train on Instructions and Responses

A dataset mixes user requests, context, and ideal assistant answers. Only the assistant portion should usually teach the response loss.

Supervised fine-tuning formats each conversation with the model’s chat template and masks tokens that should not count as targets.

Split by source or scenario so near-duplicate examples do not leak into validation. Evaluate both the target behavior and broad capabilities that might regress.
common_mistakes: Fine-tuning changes behavior without any examples.
Every input token should always be treated as the desired assistant output.
A preference dataset represents universal values automatically.
mini_exercise: Draw “Train on Instructions and Responses” as three labeled steps, then explain what changes at each step.
real_world_usage: Fine-tuning can shape format, domain behavior, and task skill when prompting or retrieval is insufficient.
explain_back_prompt: Using “Train on Instructions and Responses,” explain Fine-Tuning Methods without assuming the listener knows modern AI.
